hyperedges.label: Semantic extraction: dispatch, cache, and manifest stamping contract
Incremental rebuild: detect, merge, reconcile, guard, write
Corpus scoping: ignore files, exclude persistence, and sensitive-path screens

nodes.label: Release 0.9.25 (2026-07-22)
nodes.rationale: Relicensed MIT -> Apache 2.0 for an explicit patent grant, patent-retaliation clause, and explicit contribution terms; pre-relicensing contributions remain available under MIT via LICENSE-MIT.

nodes.label: graphify extract
nodes.rationale: Takes an explicit `root` anchor pinned to the scan root so the cache location is decoupled from the id/relativization anchor, keeping graph.json resolvable and portable.

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: Nodes are ranked by hop distance from the seeds and the named seed is never truncated, because degree ordering cut the definition node first and silence read as absence.

nodes.label: graphify explain
nodes.rationale: Cut connections on a high-degree node are grouped by file rather than a bare '... and N more' so callers beyond the top 20 stay visible without a repo-wide grep.

nodes.label: graphify path
nodes.rationale: Traversal runs over a sorted graph so equal-length routes are deterministic instead of hash-seed dependent.

nodes.label: graphify install
nodes.rationale: Refuses to modify a settings file it cannot parse and backs up to <name>.graphify-bak before any modifying write, because the empty-config fallback destroyed user settings.

nodes.label: graphify uninstall
nodes.rationale: Matches the graphify heading only when a line is exactly the marker, so a user-authored '### graphify' section is never stripped.

nodes.label: detect()
nodes.rationale: Every pruned-as-noise directory is recorded in a `pruned_noise_dirs` bucket and ignored paths in an `ignored` field, so an over-broad rule no longer looks like a clean scan.

nodes.label: graphify prs
nodes.rationale: All subprocess reads pass encoding=utf-8, errors=replace so Windows cp1252 decoding cannot mojibake or crash on non-ASCII PR titles.

nodes.label: graphify export obsidian
nodes.rationale: Only notes tracked in graphify's ownership manifest are pruned, with a vault-containment guard, so user-authored notes are never touched.

nodes.label: merge-chunks
nodes.rationale: A malformed chunk is skipped with a warning rather than aborting the whole merge, so one bad chunk cannot discard good ones.

nodes.label: get_neighbors (MCP)
nodes.rationale: Honors a token_budget (default 2000) so one call on a god node cannot flood the client's context.

nodes.label: build_from_json
nodes.rationale: Folds legacy field aliases and re-keys absolute-derived ids to the canonical root-relative id, because nodes carrying them entered the graph without a label or source_file and were invisible and unmergeable.

nodes.label: build_merge
nodes.rationale: A file present in new_chunks is being replaced, not deleted, so 'replace' wins over a contradictory prune of the same source.

nodes.label: detect_incremental
nodes.rationale: An absent manifest is treated as 'everything new / nothing deleted', so an existing graph.json alone is a sufficient incremental baseline.

nodes.label: save_manifest
nodes.rationale: Accepts a clear_semantic set and forces semantic_hash to empty for those files, so the subset-save seed loop cannot inherit a stale hash and mask an LLM-omitted doc.

nodes.label: save_semantic_cache
nodes.rationale: Writes honor an allowed_source_files allowlist so a model's mis-attributed source_file cannot clobber another file's complete cache entry.

nodes.label: check_semantic_cache
nodes.rationale: Pre-fingerprint entries are still served rather than re-billing a whole corpus, but their count is warned about so the vintage gap is visible.

nodes.label: semantic cache
nodes.rationale: Entries are namespaced by a fingerprint of the extraction prompt and by mode, so they survive releases that don't touch the prompt but invalidate when it changes; old-fingerprint entries are pruned by liveness only so two hosts can share one graphify-out/.

nodes.label: extract_corpus_parallel
nodes.rationale: Diffs the dispatched file set against returned source_files into uncovered_files, so a document the model silently omits is no longer lost without a trace.

nodes.label: _rebuild_code
nodes.rationale: A doc that already has a semantic layer is not AST-quick-scanned, because double representation inflated a real corpus ~4x.

nodes.label: _reconcile_existing_graph
nodes.rationale: Eviction fails closed: a corpus-absent source is only evicted when the path truly does not exist, because an ignore-rule change looks identical to a deletion.

nodes.label: _stamped_manifest_files
nodes.rationale: Only files that actually produced nodes, edges, or hyperedges are stamped, per the never-stamp-a-failed-chunk contract.

nodes.label: _semantic_id_remap
nodes.rationale: Skips an id that already carries its canonical stem so the remap is idempotent; otherwise persisted _origin re-fed ids through the legacy branch and grew them unboundedly.

nodes.label: _score_query
nodes.rationale: Computes the combined ranking and each token's singleton winner in a single traversal instead of re-scoring per term, making cost independent of query length.

nodes.label: _pick_seeds
nodes.rationale: Seed selection deduplicates by normalized label so homonymous generic symbols cannot consume every BFS seed slot; the cap is scoping-only and leaves the shared scorer untouched.

nodes.label: _rewire_unique_stub_nodes
nodes.rationale: Top-level function defs become eligible rewire targets when the label match is globally unique, gated on a language-family match and excluding supertype stubs since you don't inherit from a function.

nodes.label: _disambiguate_colliding_node_ids
nodes.rationale: An import/re-export edge carries the resolved target file as a transient salt key that is popped once consumed, keeping graph.json deterministic and byte-identical across checkout locations; the extension-aware-id alternative was rejected as it would force a full-rebuild migration.

nodes.label: _is_sensitive
nodes.rationale: The sensitive-dir list is split: dedicated credential stores drop everything, while ambiguous bare-name dirs like secrets/ spare genuine source, since those are as often real packages as credential stores.

nodes.label: _is_graphable_source
nodes.rationale: Extracted into a shared predicate so the Stage 1 directory screen and Stage 3 filename screen cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: _xaml_csharp_class_nodes
nodes.rationale: Walks with noise-dir pruning and a directory cap so a runaway project root degrades to a fast partial scan instead of hanging on a whole tree.

nodes.label: _resolve_graphify_exe
nodes.rationale: Normalizes backslashes to forward slashes at a single choke point because Git Bash treats backslashes as escapes and drops them.

nodes.label: to_graphml
nodes.rationale: Coerces None to empty string and JSON-serializes non-scalars because nx.write_graphml accepts only scalar values.

nodes.label: file_hash
nodes.rationale: The stat-index memo stores one digest per path salt; legacy un-salted entries are recomputed rather than trusted, since one file hashed under two roots produced an order-dependent result.

nodes.label: shrink guard
nodes.rationale: Refuses to overwrite a larger existing graph when a run was incomplete unless --allow-partial is passed; a present-but-unparseable existing graph fails closed because a corrupt file could be hiding a complete graph.

nodes.label: dedup
nodes.rationale: The survivor of an ID collision is chosen by a total order (definer first, then canonical label, then lexically) so it does not depend on chunk arrival order.

nodes.label: atomic JSON artifact writes
nodes.rationale: Writes go to a temp file in the same directory and os.replace into place, writing through a symlink so shared-store setups keep working; a truncated graph.json otherwise wedged every later run via the shrink guard.

nodes.label: extract_bash
nodes.rationale: Resolution is in-corpus and single-match only, so a genuine external command matches nothing and fabricates no edge; bare-name source bindings are marked INFERRED since they resolve via $PATH at runtime.

nodes.label: extract_sln
nodes.rationale: Solution folders are detected (name == path) and keyed off the folder name only, because a virtual grouping is not a file and its absolute id leaked the local username into a committed graph.json.

nodes.label: pg_introspect
nodes.rationale: FK DDL is emitted before function stubs so table-to-table references edges cannot be swallowed by a later unparseable routine's tree-sitter ERROR region.

nodes.label: SQL extractor
nodes.rationale: The raw-text routine recovery is gated on a failed parse so a cleanly-parsing file cannot fabricate routines from commented-out DDL or EXECUTE strings.

nodes.label: PHP extractor
nodes.rationale: A namespace/use-aware resolution pass mirrors the Java resolver and runs before the unique-name rewire; provably-external types are parked on a fully-qualified stub the bare-name rewire cannot collapse.

nodes.label: C# member-call resolution
nodes.rationale: Shadow-poisoning ensures a local shadowing a field of a different type no longer produces a wrong edge.

nodes.label: Python import/call resolution
nodes.rationale: Absolute imports resolve against nested package roots detected via the __init__.py chain, so the graph is identical whether scanned from the repo root or from src/.

nodes.label: Kotlin builtin type filtering
nodes.rationale: User types that legitimately share a name (Result, framework types) are deliberately not filtered, consistent with the other languages.

nodes.label: indirect_call callable guard
nodes.rationale: Classes are tracked separately and excluded from indirect_call; the suppression is context-blind, so a genuine invoked class callback also loses its edge — the intended tradeoff.

nodes.label: cache/stat-index.json
nodes.rationale: Stored with root-relative keys and pruned of deleted-file entries so a moved or cloned corpus keeps its cache hits and the index stops growing unbounded.

nodes.label: .graphify_build.json
nodes.rationale: Persists --exclude and --no-gitignore settings so they survive into update/watch/hook rebuilds instead of applying only to the initial scan.

nodes.label: .graphify_labels.json
nodes.rationale: Placeholder-only runs no longer persist the sidecar and a stored placeholder is treated as absent, so already-polluted graphs self-heal.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Patterns are matched relative to the directory whose ignore file defined them and follow git segment semantics (* per segment, ** spans segments).

nodes.label: .gitignore / info/exclude
nodes.rationale: info/exclude is loaded at lowest precedence, matching git, so a nearer ! re-include still wins; the files are read as utf-8-sig so a BOM cannot swallow the first pattern.

nodes.label: .graphifyinclude (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed because it had been non-functional since dot directories became indexed by default; use ! negation patterns in .graphifyignore instead.

nodes.label: exported graph.html report
nodes.rationale: The node id is carried in an HTML-escaped data-nid attribute and dispatched through one delegated listener, closing a stored XSS from unescaped ids/labels scraped via graphify add <url>.

nodes.label: PreToolUse hook (graphify-first nudge)
nodes.rationale: Stops firing for reads outside the indexed project and softens to a nudge when the graph is stale; gating is ~3 stat calls with no corpus walk and fails open on any error.

nodes.label: strict hook mode
nodes.rationale: Blocks only the first raw source read of a session then downgrades to the soft nudge, so it can never strand the agent; Claude Code only because Gemini/Codex/OpenCode cannot hard-block.

nodes.label: post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Short-circuits in a linked worktree (git-dir != git-common-dir) comparing absolute paths, so the primary checkout is never false-positived.

nodes.label: hook rebuild timeout
nodes.rationale: A threading.Timer fallback arms the timeout where signal.SIGALRM is unavailable (Windows); the Unix path is unchanged.

nodes.label: serve.py
nodes.rationale: The JSONDecodeError clause is ordered first because it subclasses ValueError and the broad clause shadowed the documented rebuild hint.

nodes.label: claude-cli backend
nodes.rationale: Pins a JSON schema when the CLI supports it (feature-detected, old prompt as fallback) and parses structured_output, because newer Claude Code reports a prose summary in `result` that parsed to zero nodes.

nodes.label: Ollama backend auto-detection
nodes.rationale: OLLAMA_HOST is honored but an explicit OLLAMA_BASE_URL still wins, so ollama stays opt-in and never shadows a configured paid key.

nodes.label: unverified node verification flag
nodes.rationale: A code-typed node whose symbol never appears in its source is flagged rather than dropped, so a possibly-hallucinated symbol is not presented as a read fact but no real node is lost.

nodes.label: extraction process pool
nodes.rationale: Skipped when only one worker is available, falling back to in-process sequential extraction, which also removes the last case where a hung Windows hook rebuild could orphan a worker.
